dialogues.speaker: Maksim
dialogues.text: Oh, this is the greatest place in all of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Maksim
dialogues.text: Ah, a venue like this would be an impossibility in the bitter cold of Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Maksim
dialogues.text: Ahem... Although I originally intended to do business here in Liyue, I must say that I have forgotten all such thoughts already...

dialogues.speaker: Maksim
dialogues.text: Even if Lady Ningguang herself were to summon me to the Jade Chamber to talk business, I may not go.
